**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Article 5 grant to us already sits at the playbook's preferred position:

- **Affiliates and contractors** — Section 5.1.3 grants AbbVie an exclusive licence and right of reference to Exploit the Licensed Compounds/Products, and Section 5.3 expressly permits sublicensing "through multiple tiers of Sublicensees … to its Affiliates and other Persons." Sections 5.4/5.5 add distributor and co-promote rights at our sole discretion, and Section 13.16 confirms performance by our Affiliates.
- **Not revocable at will by Harpoon** — Harpoon can terminate only for uncured material breach (Section 12.2.1, 90-day cure, further limited by Section 12.2.3) or insolvency; the "for any or no reason" termination right in Section 12.3 belongs to us.
- **Paid-up/irrevocable on expiry** — Section 12.1.2 converts the Section 5.1.3 grants to "non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable."
- **Successor transfer** — Section 13.4.1 allows assignment without consent to an Affiliate or to an M&A successor, and binds the grant on Harpoon's successors/assignees.

No material term falls short, so nothing to flag under LICENSE.
